title: Workload Identity Configuration
description: Operator-facing configuration for the standalone node-local workload identity collector. The collector reads CRI/runtime metadata and writes bounded snapshots for ServiceRadar agent ingest.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for node-local workload identity collection. Assigning the add-on is the security opt-in; set this false to keep the service installed but idle.

root.title: Discovery root
root.description: Filesystem root used for CRI endpoint discovery. Leave as / on live hosts.

cri_endpoint.title: CRI endpoint
cri_endpoint.description: Optional explicit CRI Unix socket path. Leave empty to discover common endpoints such as /run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock, /run/containerd/containerd.sock, and /var/run/crio/crio.sock.

docker_endpoint.title: Docker endpoint
docker_endpoint.description: Optional explicit Docker Engine Unix socket path. Leave empty to discover common endpoints such as /var/run/docker.sock.

runtime.title: Runtime source
runtime.description: Optional runtime selector. Use auto discovery by default, containerd/crio/cri for Kubernetes CRI sockets, or docker for Docker and Docker Compose hosts.

socket.title: Runtime socket
socket.description: Optional Unix socket path for the selected runtime type.

context_name.title: Context name
context_name.description: Operator-facing workload context stamped onto emitted workload identity. For Kubernetes this should match the kubeconfig context or another stable human-recognizable environment name. CRI does not expose this reliably, so set it when multiple clusters or container environments report into the same ServiceRadar deployment.

cluster_id.title: Cluster ID
cluster_id.description: Legacy stable cluster identifier stamped onto emitted workload identity. Prefer context_name for user-facing investigation labels.

cluster_name.title: Cluster name
cluster_name.description: Legacy human-friendly cluster name stamped onto emitted workload identity. Prefer context_name for new assignments.

refresh_interval_s.title: Refresh interval (s)
refresh_interval_s.description: How often the collector refreshes node-local runtime metadata. Values below 10 seconds are clamped by the collector.

spool_dir.title: Spool directory
spool_dir.description: Directory where the collector publishes bounded identity snapshots for local agent ingest.

max_identities.title: Maximum identities per snapshot
max_identities.description: Upper bound on identities written to one snapshot. Larger nodes emit a degradation marker and truncate the snapshot until streaming ingest is enabled.
